title: Split-emission configuration
statement: Given a natural number $k$, Boolean lists $w$ and $s$, an optional state from $	ext{Fin}(4)$, natural numbers $j$ and $h$, and a Boolean output list, define a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes on input $w$. Its input-head position is the split position determined by $w$ and $j$; its first work tape is the buffer tape determined by $s$, each remaining work tape is the catalog polynomial tape with length parameter $|s|+1$, the first work-head position is $h$, and the remaining work-head positions are $0$; its state and output are the specified ones.
